maya: Heads up — I merged #4128 (small kv-cache opt) and main turned red immediately. Failing job: `runtime-e2e:smoke`. Not sure this is my change but pinging owners. @chris can you take a look? :wave:
ci-bot: [BUILD FAILED] branch=main build=8791 job=runtime-e2e:smoke
ci-bot: failed task log: https://ci.internal/red/8791/runtime-e2e-smoke (exit code 1)
chris: on it. can you paste the failing test name / snippet?
maya: here's the tail from the runner logs:

```
E   AssertionError: Key mismatch after eviction
tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::smoke_kv_cache_eviction_test
  File "/srv/build/venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/redis_util.py", line 128, in get
    assert value is not None
E   AssertionError
```

maya: test is `smoke_kv_cache_eviction_test`. run id: node-7.
linh: hmm saw a couple infra bumps yesterday (container runtime + driver). could be flakiness or an image mismatch. recommend a rerun first, then bisect if it persists.
sven: kicking a retry now: `/retest job=runtime-e2e:smoke --node node-7 --collect-logs` :gear:
ci-bot: [RERUN STARTED] rerun_id=8791-1 link=https://ci.internal/red/8791/rerun/1
ci-bot: [RERUN COMPLETE] rerun_id=8791-1 status=failed same_test=smoke_kv_cache_eviction_test node=node-7
chris: thanks — same failure on rerun, marking as not simple flake. I'll start a bisect across recent infra commits (container-runtime and gpu-driver bumps). guessing range: 1768000..1769050.
chris: running `./scripts/infra-bisect --job runtime-e2e:smoke --test smoke_kv_cache_eviction_test --range 1768000..1769050` now. will post updates. :mag:
maya: thx. i'll pin my PR (revert if you find infra break) and stand by to open rollback if needed. :+1:
chris: quick note for triage log: captured core dumps and /var/log/nvidia-driver.log from node-7, uploaded to https://artifacts.internal/ci/8791-1/ (paths: cores/, driver.log).
linh: if bisect points to driver, we should put a temporary platform hold and notify infra team.
chris: agreed. will escalate once bisect gives a suspect commit. adding @infra-team in the thread if needed. :eyes:
ci-bot: [NOTE] build failure has been annotated with `triage: in_progress`
chris: update: bisect narrowed to commit 1768523 (container runtime -> runc 1.1.3 -> 1.2.0). reproducer queued against that snapshot. will confirm in ~20m and update.
maya: appreciate it — thanks for the fast triage everyone.
